# Independent lost-ID recovery evidence

Two fresh Luna contexts received only their isolated config paths, ECON901,
the week beginning 2026-10-12, the source prep skill and a request to complete
already-saved work without replacements. No task/capture UUIDs or intended
answers were supplied. Raw inputs were the invented `host-numeric` sources.
This is manual source-skill selection, not installed-plugin activation or an
actual `/goal` controller interruption.

The ordinary agent recovered `1054ddf7-e3a2-4fc8-9ff3-964fd954b7f5` and saved
`01 Prep Brief.v2.md`, preserving the older completed brief for task
`3ae7e529-47e4-4df8-acc1-e256e93456a0`. The frozen agent recovered
`60490fb5-f267-4d19-a9c1-f4142137ea6d`, bound to capture
`98d48565-26af-423a-af44-454102e61ed8`, and reached completed-pending-human.
It did not create a replacement capture/task or set a human verdict.

Before delegation, 22 existing files were hashed. Afterward, only the ordinary
pending task.json changed, as expected on completion; all other baseline bytes
were unchanged. Ordinary task directories remained exactly the two original
IDs, and the frozen task directory retained its one original ID. Local full
evidence and the baseline remain in `/tmp/canvas-agent-recovery-o9lUiy`, which
is temporary and not guaranteed to survive machine cleanup. Candidates here
replace only their task UUID with a replay placeholder; batch files retain
the agents' actual four operations.

Recovery/preservation passed, but quantitative-verification acceptance did not:
both briefs add a 200-unit forecast-minus-break-even comparison without executing
that calculation. Their four logged values are 20, 12000, 4000 and 400. Do not
retroactively call every reported number verified or use these artifacts as
academic-quality gold answers. The frozen agent also reported retrying an
unsupported operation label; the initial invalid batch was not retained, so that
attempt is report-only evidence. Calculator help was subsequently improved to
advertise supported operation names and a runnable batch shape. It does not
resolve the unexecuted prose-comparison failure.
